div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/pheref/CodeSystem/ereferral-workflow defines the following codes:

tr.td: The receiving facility has acknowledged receipt of the referral and is reviewing whether it can take the case.
The receiving facility can take the case and has given a positive transfer or service response.
The receiving facility cannot take the case and no onward receiving facility is identified in the same response.
The receiving facility cannot take the case and directs the patient or referral to another specified facility.
The receiving facility reports that capacity is full.
A ServiceRequest created or identified as the next referral request after the initial receiving facility refers the case onward.
A summary of the referral service outcome.
